-- Bridge retail SKUs to Shopify-staged products when both exist (SKU embedded in variants JSON).


with retail_skus as (
    select distinct sku, name, product_id, variant_id
    from "data"."greenfield"."retail_products"
)

select
    rs.sku as greenfield_retail_sku,
    rs.name as greenfield_product_name,
    rs.product_id as greenfield_product_id,
    sp.id as shopify_product_row_id,
    sp.title as shopify_product_title,
    sp.vendor as shopify_vendor,
    case
        when sp.variants is null then false
        else strpos(cast(sp.variants as varchar), rs.sku) > 0
    end as sku_found_in_shopify_variants_json
from retail_skus rs
left join "data"."shopify"."shopify_products" sp
    on strpos(cast(sp.variants as varchar), rs.sku) > 0

-- Reconcile ground-truth retail orders with extracted_orders (same keys as generator).


with retail as (
    select * from "data"."greenfield"."retail_orders"
),

extracted as (
    select * from "data"."greenfield"."extracted_orders"
)

select
    r.order_id as retail_order_id,
    r.order_number,
    r.customer_id as retail_customer_id,
    r.source_tx_id,
    r.source_invoice_no,
    r.payment_ref as retail_payment_ref,
    r.grand_total as retail_grand_total,
    e.doc_id,
    e.extraction_id,
    e.grand_total as extracted_grand_total,
    abs(coalesce(e.grand_total, 0) - coalesce(r.grand_total, 0)) as grand_total_abs_diff
from retail r
left join extracted e
    on r.source_tx_id = e.source_tx_id
    and r.source_invoice_no = e.source_invoice_no

with source as (
    select * from "data"."shopify"."shopify_orders"
),

staged as (
    select
        -- Explicitly cast all ID fields as VARCHAR
        cast(id as varchar) as id,
        
        -- Order fields
        name,
        email,
        phone,
        
        -- Timestamps
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        processed_at,
        cancelled_at,
        
        -- Order details
        cancel_reason,
        
        -- Pricing information (JSON fields)
        total_price_set,
        subtotal_price_set,
        total_tax_set,
        total_shipping_price_set,
        
        -- Customer information (JSON field)
        customer,
        
        -- Addresses (JSON fields)
        shipping_address,
        billing_address,
        
        -- Line items (JSON field with nested IDs)
        line_items,
        
        -- Metadata
        'shopify' as source_system,
        current_timestamp as dbt_loaded_at
    from source
)

with base_table_1 as (
    select 
        'TXN_' || cast(row_number() over () as varchar) as transaction_id,
        'ORD_' || cast(row_number() over () as varchar) as order_id,
        'CUST_' || cast(row_number() over () as varchar) as customer_id,
        case 
            when random() < 0.3 then 'pending'
            when random() < 0.6 then 'completed'
            else 'failed'
        end as transaction_status,
        case 
            when random() < 0.4 then 'credit_card'
            when random() < 0.7 then 'paypal'
            else 'shop_pay'
        end as payment_method,
        round(random() * 1000 + 10, 2) as transaction_amount,
        round(random() * 50 + 5, 2) as tax_amount,
        round(random() * 20 + 2, 2) as shipping_amount,
        'USD' as currency,
        current_timestamp - interval '1 day' * random() * 30 as created_at,
        current_timestamp - interval '1 day' * random() * 30 as updated_at,
        case 
            when random() < 0.8 then 'US'
            when random() < 0.9 then 'CA'
            else 'UK'
        end as country_code,
        case 
            when random() < 0.7 then 'online'
            else 'in_store'
        end as sales_channel,

-- Fact: Shopify-style transactions with derived measures (from base union).


select
    transaction_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    transaction_status,
    payment_method,
    transaction_amount,
    tax_amount,
    shipping_amount,
    currency,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    country_code,
    sales_channel,
    source_table,
    transaction_amount + tax_amount + shipping_amount as total_amount,
    case
        when transaction_status = 'completed' then transaction_amount
        else 0
    end as successful_amount,
    case
        when created_at >= current_timestamp - interval '7 days' then 'recent'
        when created_at >= current_timestamp - interval '30 days' then 'recent_month'
        else 'older'
    end as transaction_recency,
    case
        when transaction_amount >= 1000 then 'high_value'
        when transaction_amount >= 500 then 'medium_value'
        else 'low_value'
    end as transaction_value_category,
    case
        when payment_method = 'credit_card' then 'card'
        when payment_method = 'paypal' then 'digital_wallet'
        else 'shop_pay'
    end as payment_category
from "data"."base"."shopify_transactions_base"
